provenance: Written by hand for judge calibration on 2026-11-01. Every person, employer and school is fictional; any resemblance is coincidental. Each pair isolates one rule in docs/evals/critical-miss-rubric.md. Both sides are grounded and specific unless the rule under test says otherwise.
scoring: A decisive pair is right when the combined verdict names the expected side. A tie control is right when the verdict is a tie, acceptable when it is a slight preference, and wrong when it is a clear preference.
